essentialQuestion.source: How can AI help a community get its problems fixed, and who does the fixing?
essentialQuestion.back: How can AI help a community so that its problems are fixed, and who fixes them?

learningGoal.source: Explain how Traffy Fondue in Thailand uses AI to sort and send residents' reports, why people and agencies still fix the problems, and what its numbers can and can't show.
learningGoal.back: Explain how Traffy Fondue in Thailand uses AI to group and send residents' reports, why people and agencies are still the ones who fix the problems, and what its numbers can and can't show.
learningGoal.note: "Sort" is "mengelompokkan" (put into groups) throughout, which children know better than "memilah".

evidence.cards.0.title.source: How a report travels in Traffy Fondue, Thailand
evidence.cards.0.title.back: The journey of a report in Traffy Fondue, Thailand

evidence.cards.0.items.0.source: 1. A resident sees a problem, such as a broken street light or a flooded road.
evidence.cards.0.items.0.back: 1. A resident sees a problem, such as a broken street light or a flooded road.

evidence.cards.0.items.1.source: 2. In the LINE messaging app, they send a photo and a short description. The place is added from the phone's location.
evidence.cards.0.items.1.back: 2. In the LINE messaging app, the resident sends a photo and a short description. The place is taken from the phone's location.

evidence.cards.0.items.2.source: 3. AI sorts the report by type and sends it to the office that is responsible.
evidence.cards.0.items.2.back: 3. AI groups the report by its type and sends it to the office that is responsible.

evidence.cards.0.items.3.source: 4. People at that office check the report and decide what to do. Some jobs go to a repair team. Bigger ones need money and a plan.
evidence.cards.0.items.3.back: 4. Staff at that office check the report and decide what must be done. Some jobs are handed to a repair team. Bigger jobs need funds and a plan.
evidence.cards.0.items.3.note: "Officials" and "people at the office" are "petugas" (staff on duty) throughout the lesson; "pejabat" is kept for officials who give an award, since it suggests senior rank.

evidence.cards.0.items.4.source: 5. The office posts updates. The resident can follow the report and rate the result.
evidence.cards.0.items.4.back: 5. The office posts the latest news. The resident can follow their report and give the result a rating.

read.sections.0.text.source: In every city, residents notice problems first: a road with a hole in it, a blocked drain, a street light that has stopped working. Fixing them is the job of the city's offices. But a report has to reach the right office, and in a big city there are many. In Thailand, researchers at NECTEC, part of the country's national science agency, NSTDA, built a platform to help. It is called Traffy Fondue. In May 2022, Bangkok's city government began to use it for reports from residents. Since then, many other towns, offices and agencies across Thailand have joined.
read.sections.0.text.back: In every city, residents are the first to see problems: a road with holes, a blocked drain, a street light that has gone out. Fixing them is the job of the city government's offices. But a report has to reach the right office, and in a big city there are many offices. In Thailand, researchers at NECTEC, part of the country's national science agency, NSTDA, built a platform to help. It is called Traffy Fondue. In May 2022, Bangkok's city government began using it for reports from residents. Since then, many other towns, offices and agencies across Thailand have joined.
read.sections.0.text.note: "Agency" is "lembaga" (institution, agency) throughout; "instansi" (a government agency) is the official word and a reviewer may prefer it. KEY_TERMS's "agency" ("berdaya", Lesson 19) is a different sense. "Resident" is "warga", as TERMS.md.

read.sections.1.heading.source: What the AI does, and what people do
read.sections.1.heading.back: What the AI does, and what people do

read.sections.1.text.source: To make a report, a resident uses LINE, a messaging app. They send a photo, a few words and the place. Then AI reads the report and sorts it by type, such as roads, flooding or lights. The system sends it to the office that should deal with it. Sorting and sending is the AI's part of the work. After that, people take over. Officials check the report and decide what to do. Some jobs need only a repair team. A bigger job may need money, a plan and more time. The AI routes the report. People and agencies do the fixing.
read.sections.1.text.back: To make a report, residents use LINE, a messaging app. They send a photo, a few words and the place. Then AI reads the report and groups it by its type, for example roads, floods or lights. The system sends the report to the office that should handle it. Grouping and sending is the AI's part of the work. After that, people take over. Staff check the report and decide what must be done. Some jobs only need a repair team. A bigger job may need funds, a plan and more time. The AI directs the report. People and agencies are the ones who fix it.
read.sections.1.text.note: "Route" is "mengarahkan" (direct, send the right way); "meneruskan" (pass on) is a possible alternative.

read.sections.1.simpler.source: A resident makes a report in LINE, a messaging app. They send a photo, some words and where it is. Then AI reads the report. It sorts it by type, like roads or floods. It sends it to the right office. That is the AI's part. Then people take over. Officials check the report and send workers. A big job needs money and a plan too. So the AI routes the report. People and agencies fix the problem.
read.sections.1.simpler.back: A resident makes a report in LINE, a messaging app. They send a photo, a few words and the place. Then AI reads the report. AI puts the report in one group, like roads or floods. AI sends it to the right office. That is the AI's part of the work. Then people take over. Staff check the report and send workers. A big job also needs funds and a plan. So the AI directs the report. People and agencies fix the problem.

read.sections.2.heading.source: What the numbers can and can't show
read.sections.2.heading.back: What numbers can and can't show

read.sections.2.text.source: Bangkok says it received 588,842 reports in two years and resolved about 79% of them. These numbers come from the city and the platform's makers, and "resolved" means an official closed the case. In 2025, Bangkok's governor told officials not to close cases with photos that had nothing to do with the problem. So a closed case is not always a fixed problem. In 2025, researchers at Thammasat University in Bangkok studied 98,000 reports and talked with 12 people who knew the system. They found it helped the city see where problems were and plan repairs. They also noted that it needs a smartphone and the internet, which not everyone has.
read.sections.2.text.back: Bangkok says it has received 588,842 reports in two years and resolved about 79% of them. These numbers come from the city government and the platform's makers, and "resolved" means a staff member has closed the report. In 2025, Bangkok's governor asked staff not to close reports with photos that had nothing to do with the problem. So a report that has been closed does not necessarily mean the problem has been fixed. In 2025, researchers at Thammasat University in Bangkok studied 98,000 reports and talked with 12 people who knew the system. They found that the platform helped the city government see where there were problems and plan repairs. They also noted that the platform needs a smartphone and the internet, which not everyone has.
read.sections.2.text.note: "Resolve" is "menyelesaikan" and "resolved" "diselesaikan" (dealt with until finished). Bangkok's governor is "Gubernur Bangkok", as Indonesian news says.

read.sections.2.simpler.source: Bangkok says it got 588,842 reports in two years. It says about 79% were resolved. These numbers come from the city and the makers. Resolved means an official closed the case. In 2025, the city's leader warned officials about one problem. Some closed cases with photos that did not show the problem. So a closed case is not always a fixed problem. University researchers studied 98,000 reports. It helped the city plan repairs, they found. But it needs a smartphone and the internet.
read.sections.2.simpler.back: Bangkok says it has received 588,842 reports in two years. It says about 79% have been resolved. This number comes from the city government and the makers. Resolved means a staff member has closed the report. In 2025, the city's leader warned staff about one problem. Some closed reports with photos that did not show the problem. So a closed report has not necessarily been fixed. University researchers studied 98,000 reports. The platform helped the city plan repairs, they say. But the platform needs a smartphone and the internet.

watch.summary.source: In this video, people who build and study AI talk about fairness. AI tools learn from data, and they are already used in many parts of life. The speakers say AI could help more people get what they need. But AI can also be unfair. If the data, or the people who build a tool, leave some groups out, the tool can work worse for those groups or treat them unfairly. This is called algorithmic bias. The speakers say that people from many different backgrounds should help to build AI. They also say that people must keep checking AI tools, so that the tools help everyone and don't harm the people they leave out.
watch.summary.back: In this video, people who make and study AI talk about fairness. AI tools learn from data, and they are already used in many parts of life. The speakers say AI could help more people get what they need. But AI can also be unfair. If the data, or the people who make the tool, leave out certain groups, the tool can work worse for those groups or treat them unfairly. This is called algorithmic bias. The speakers say people from many backgrounds should help make AI. They also say humans must keep checking AI tools, so that the tools help everyone and don't harm the people left behind.

educatorNotes.0.source: What the sources establish (claims/DW10.md). Traffy Fondue was developed by NECTEC, part of Thailand's National Science and Technology Development Agency (NSTDA). Bangkok's city government launched it on 31 May 2022 (Hansen and Dahiya, 2025); residents report through a LINE chatbot with a photo, a description, a category and the place. The researchers describe an AI engine that sorts reports into categories and a workflow that sends each to the responsible agency; NSTDA's 2024 statement adds AI summaries, suggested priorities and filtering of rude language. Repairs are done by the agencies, their teams or contractors; bigger jobs go through evaluation, budgeting and a project. All the scale and speed figures are the city's or the makers' own: Bangkok's 588,842 reports in two years with about 79% resolved (June 2024, from the governor's report, "resolved" not defined); NSTDA's 2026 page (all 77 provinces, 34,786 agencies, over 2 million resolved tickets, average resolution time down from 90 to 15 days). No independent check of repair quality was found. The Thammasat study (98,000 reports, May to December 2022, 12 interviews) reports 84% satisfaction and estimated savings, and notes the platform is digital-first.
educatorNotes.0.back: What the sources establish (claims/DW10.md). Traffy Fondue was developed by NECTEC, part of Thailand's National Science and Technology Development Agency (NSTDA). Bangkok's city government launched it on 31 May 2022 (Hansen and Dahiya, 2025); residents report through a LINE chatbot with a photo, a description, a category and the place. The researchers describe an AI engine that groups reports into categories and a workflow that sends each report to the responsible agency; NSTDA's 2024 statement adds AI-made summaries, suggested priorities and filtering of rude language. Repairs are done by those agencies, their teams or contractors; bigger jobs go through assessment, budgeting and a project. All figures on scale and speed come from the city government or the makers themselves: 588,842 reports in Bangkok in two years with about 79% resolved (June 2024, from the governor's report; "resolved" not defined); NSTDA's 2026 page (all 77 provinces, 34,786 agencies, more than 2 million resolved tickets, average resolution time down from 90 to 15 days). No independent check of the quality of the repairs was found. The Thammasat study (98,000 reports, May to December 2022, 12 interviews) reports 84% satisfaction and estimated savings, and notes that the platform puts digital means first.
